summary: Constellation Energy Corp (CEG) and its subsidiary Constellation Energy Generation LLC filed an 8-K/A to amend a prior filing regarding the completed acquisition of Calpine Corp via merger. The Merger Agreement dated January 10, 2025, closed on January 7, 2026, making Calpine a wholly-owned indirect subsidiary of CEG. Terms such as price per share and premium were not restated in this amendment. The filing only updates an auditor’s report and consent. Watch for integration updates and potential cost synergies from the combination of two large power generators.
